standard_prerequisites.name: The existence of an ideal of definition generated by d elements, where d is the dimension of the local ring, and the bound of the cohomological dimension by the number of generators
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 818-822), the second being a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the cohomological dimension is at most d, so that the remaining task is to exclude the strict inequality.

standard_prerequisites.name: The behaviour of the cohomological dimension under the passage to the completion, and the existence of a normalized dualizing complex on a complete local ring with the local duality theorem
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 827-836 and 840-846) as pointers to lemmas of other chapters
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the problem to a complete local ring, where local duality identifies the top local cohomology with a module that is known to be nonzero.

core_obligations: Upper bound and reformulation: an ideal of definition generated by d elements gives cohomological dimension at most d, so the three assertions that the top local cohomology is nonzero, that the cohomological dimension is d, and that it is at least d are equivalent (proof lines 818-824)

Pass to the completion: the completion is again a Noetherian local ring of the same dimension with maximal ideal the extension of the given one, and the behaviour of cohomological dimension under the passage to the completion allows the proof to assume the ring complete (proof lines 826-836)

Local duality: a complete local ring has a normalized dualizing complex, and local duality identifies the top local cohomology of the ring with the Matlis dual of a degree of that complex, which is nonzero by the nonvanishing statement for a dualizing complex (proof lines 838-849)
proof_roadmap: 由「维数 d 的局部环有 d 元生成的定义理想」得 cd(A,m) ≤ d（lemma-bound-cd），于是只需证 cd ≥ d。
由 cd 在完备化下的行为（lemma-cd-change-rings）化归 A 完备；完备局部环有规范化对偶复形 ω_A^∙，局部对偶定理把 H^d_m(A) 与 Ext^{-d}(A,ω_A^∙) = H^{-d}(ω_A^∙) 的 Matlis 对偶等同，后者由跨章的非消没引理非零。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the cohomological dimension of the maximal ideal of a Noetherian local ring as the dimension of the ring and shows that the top local cohomology of the ring does not vanish (author lemma at source lines 811-815, label lemma-cd-maximal). The proof (source lines 817-850) obtains the upper bound from the existence of an ideal of definition generated by d elements, observes that the three assertions of the statement are then equivalent, reduces to a complete local ring by the behaviour of cohomological dimension under completion, and concludes by identifying the top local cohomology with the Matlis dual of a degree of the normalized dualizing complex, which is nonzero (proof lines 838-849). The reduction to the complete case and the use of local duality are the content. H2.
